title: Stop Building Software Factories — Justin McCarthy, Diffusion
summary: Most of the time you don't know what you want yet, so putting new ideas through a factory wastes time and tokens. Justin McCarthy, founder and CEO of Diffusion, argues for brownfield factories instead: continuous loops that keep the promises of software customers already pay for, getting faster, cheaper and safer around the clock. title: 1,000 Claude Agents Formalized Fermat's Last Theorem — Lance Martin, Anthropic
summary: A team of 1,000 Claude agents formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean over about 30 hours, using nothing but Git and a database, with no domain-specific harness and no human steering on the solution.
